data.value: The link text shows '{0}' but the link goes to '{1}'. This counts as a sign of phishing. Make the link text and address match.

data.name: Lint_08

data.name: Lint_09
data.value: The email contains an embedded video/iframe. Email programs do not show these. Use the video's cover image and link to the video.

data.name: Lint_10
data.value: The template has no unsubscribe link. Alpixa will add one at the bottom automatically. To place it yourself, use {{ unsubscribe_url }}.

data.name: Lint_11

data.name: Lint_12

data.name: Lint_13

data.name: Lint_14
